lane: off-lattice geothermal structural emission (self-assigned; no externally assigned lane paragraph supplied for this session)
hypothesis: Proposed hypothesis (not demonstrated by the emitted raster; see post_run_code_audit): concealed geothermal feeder faults may occur in the pinned lattice 3 px coverage holes. The run proposed one dot per lattice-uncovered valid cell, ranked by public structural layers; source review found that the implementation emits all those cells, so the score ordering has no effect on output support.
mechanism: The saved artifact is binary {0,1} on all 6,649 valid footprint cells more than 300 m from every pinned lattice dot; it is not a layer-ranked subset. The original plan specified weights 0.4 (GDR Quaternary faults/SGMC), 0.3 (Quaternary volcanics), and 0.2 (paleo springs/2 m probes), but static review found W_SGMC unused and the applied terms sum to 0.9; the GDR Quaternary-fault layer receipt reports no grid intersection. The artifact uses the published DTI marginal algebra (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel) only for raster values. No holdout validates the geological premise.
named_non_fault_process: Erosional scarps, Lake Lahontan paleo-shoreline/terrace risers, lithologic contacts, and dike or flow-front edges can produce geophysical/topographic steps without fault offset.

post_run_code_audit.review_status: negative; no artifact regenerated or experiment run
source_findings: select_dots sorts uncovered cells by structural score but sets every uncovered row/column to True; ordering does not change the emitted dot support, which is all 6,649 cells.
W_SGMC is declared but unused; the score expression applies 0.4 + 0.3 + 0.2 = 0.9, contradicting the code comment that weights sum to 1.
The applied 0.4 fault term takes max(GDR Quaternary faults, SGMC faults); the pinned external receipt states the GDR Quaternary-fault layer has no features intersecting the grid.
post_run_code_audit.conclusion: The emitted raster is the lattice-complement support, not an output whose dot support was ranked by the claimed geothermal layers. No geological-hypothesis validation can be inferred.
